messages:
mara: @channel quick sprint idea — 'Snack tutorials' for OSS refkits. Goal: 3x 5-7min tutorials (code + deploy), 1x mini-benchmark blog showing cost/latency vs baseline, tie a 30-min webinar to launch. Thought timeline: 2-week sprint. Who can take what?
ben: I can own the refkit tutorials. plan: one 'get started', one 'optimize for latency', one 'deploy privately'.
chetan: I'll handle the mini-benchmark narrative and funnel. Need a narrow benchmark: 2 real workloads (chat support + summarization), run vs gpt-like baseline and a 3rd open model.
olivia: I'll draft social + webinar copy. Can we decide headline options? A/B test 'Ship LLM features faster' vs 'Cut inference cost 3x'? Also need CTAs for OSS vs hosted.
mara: Prefer cost-first for dev audiences, but webinar CTA should be 'See it in 30min'. olivia, prepare both headlines.
ben: For code, want to show small config snippets for batching + kv cache. Will add a tiny snippet in each tutorial. Eg:
```yaml
routing:
  prefer: dedicated
  fallback: hosted
```
Keep it simple.
chetan: Inbound lead routing: propose mapping webinar signups to growth + self-serve leads bounce into 'oss-interest' playbook. Rough YAML for routing:
```yaml
routes:
  - match: signup.source == "webinar"
    assign: growth
  - match: user.account_type == "self-serve"
    assign: product-led
```
Feedback?
olivia: Love it. Also propose adding 'bench signups' tag so we can A/B messaging. We should prep 2 email sequences.
mara: :thumbsup: timeline: week 1 — create content, week 2 — review + record webinar + run bench. Can we ship next Wed? If not, push one week.
ben: Next Wed tight; I'll need 4 days for write + 1 day for review. ok if we start tomorrow.
chetan: I'll parallelize bench runs. Need test infra creds from eng-sre. @mara can you unblock?
mara: On it, pinging eng-sre. Also we'll track metrics: signups, demo requests, benchmark clicks, CTR on cost claim.
deploy-bot: deployed: /marketing/campaigns/snack-sprint-draft to staging
olivia: Nice — I'll reuse slide template from last webinar. Share draft by EOD Monday.
mara: Great. Action items:
- ben: tutorials writeups + code samples
- chetan: bench doc + runs
- olivia: copy + webinar slides + email sequences
- mara: eng-sre ping + campaign setup
I'll follow up in this thread. :sparkles:
